title: sunbeam electric blanket.
text: sunbeam electric blanket.. Works well.  I will say that the picture shows a different controller than the blanket I received.  I think the one I received is actually better looking.  The blanket has a nice "pre heat" mode that is great to give your "heat" a boost and then drops to the setting you've chosen. The blanket itself is very soft. The color is well represented in pics.I have to say that I have a queen size bed that I sleep in alone, I don't need 2 controllers so I ordered the twin size.  It easily covers the whole mattress and warms right where I need it to.Just a thought if don't need 2 controllers. I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

features: Easy to use electric blanket with digital controller with 12 heat settings and 12-hour selectable auto-shut off function for peace of mind
Soft and cozy royal luxe for ideal warmth and comfort in elegant red cabernet color

description: Sleep better with the Sunbeam Royal Luxe Heated Full Size Blanket and beat those winter blues. Indulge yourself with its rich and cozy royal luxe, wrapping you in warmth and comfort all night long. Easy to use detachable controller with 12 heat settings to choose from and a 12-hour auto-shut off feature for peace of mind. This stylish blanket comes in elegant color options that are sure to compliment any decor. Remove the controller and place the blanket into the washer and dryer for easy maintenance.
